# Numan PR review instructions

Canonical review guide: [`REVIEW.md`](../../REVIEW.md) at the repository root.

Use that file for severity labels (P0–P3), architecture invariants, the review checklist, and phase-specific notes. [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) remains the source for project structure and build commands.

When this Copilot instruction file and `REVIEW.md` would otherwise diverge, update **`REVIEW.md` first**, then keep this file as a pointer (or a short summary that matches `REVIEW.md`).
